newsitem.title: FRANCE: French poll on who best placed to run economy.
newsitem.headline: French poll on who best placed to run economy.

text.p: Twenty-three percent of the French people think the RPR party is the most capable of improving the economic situation, while 14 percent think the UDF would be best, a Sofres poll conducted for daily La Croix said on Tuesday.
The RPR and UDF are the senior and junior partners respectively in the centre-right ruling coalition.
It said 30 percent of those polled said they believed the Socialist party was the most capable of improving the economic situation.
Five percent said the Communist Party would be best placed, while four percent backed the Green Party and four percent the National Front as the most capable on the economy.
Fourteen percent said they did not believe any party was capable of improving the economy.
The poll, of 1,000 people, was conducted on May 2 and 3.
